parameters.name: environment
parameters.description: The environment name, typically production, staging, and so on.

parameters.name: revision
parameters.description: A hash, number, tag, or other identifier showing what revision was deployed.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Optional URL to submit the notification to. Default: "https://api.honeybadger.io/v1/deploys"

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: The username of the person doing the deployment.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: If false, SSL certificates for the target URL are not validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Notify Honeybadger.io about an app deployment
  community.general.honeybadger_deployment:
    token: AAAAAA
    environment: staging
    user: ansible
    revision: b6826b8
    repo: 'git@github.com:user/repo.git'
